001package io.github.ai4ci.functions;
002
003import java.util.stream.IntStream;
004
005import io.github.ai4ci.util.Sampler;
006
007/**
008 * Utility class for generating and working with exotic distributions.
009 *
010 * <p>
011 * Currently includes a method for generating the distribution of distances on a
012 * square grid normalised by the length of the hypoteneuse, which can be used
013 * for modelling spatial interactions in a grid-based environment.
014 *
015 * @author Rob Challen
016 */
017public class ExoticDistributions {
018
019        /**
020         * The distribution of distances on a square grid normalised by length of
021         * hypoteneuse. This distribution arises when considering the distances
022         * between points uniformly distributed on a unit square, and normalising by
023         * the maximum distance (the length of the hypoteneuse, which is sqrt(2)).
024         * The distribution can be used for modelling spatial interactions in a
025         * grid-based environment, where the distance between points is relevant for
026         * interaction probabilities.
027         *
028         * @return an empirical distribution representing the normalised distance
029         *         distribution on a square grid
030         *
031         */
032        public static EmpiricalDistribution getEuclidianDistanceDistribution() {
033                Sampler rng = Sampler.getSampler();
034                int s = 100000;
035                double[] data = new double[s];
036                IntStream.range(0, s).parallel().forEach(i -> {
037                        data[i] = Math.sqrt(
038                                        Math.pow(rng.uniform() - rng.uniform(), 2)
039                                                        + Math.pow(rng.uniform() - rng.uniform(), 2)
040                        ) / Math.sqrt(2);
041                });
042                return EmpiricalDistribution.fromData(LinkFunction.LOGIT, data);
043        }
044
045}
